// diagnostic

E0035

An enum discriminant must be known at compile time and fit the signed integer representation used by the enum layout.

What

An enum discriminant must be known at compile time and fit the signed integer representation used by the enum layout.

Why

use a literal, a same-file `@` binding, or another comptime expression that produces an in-range integer.

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0035

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0035: tests/ui/computed_enum_noninteger.stderr.

Error [E0035]: an enum discriminant must be an integer, got Decimal (an exact base-10 number)
  --> tests/ui/computed_enum_noninteger.jet:2:13
    |
  2 |     First = 1.5
    |             ^^^
 Why: enum discriminants select a numeric variant value
 Fix: use an integer literal or a compile-time expression that produces Int
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0035
